raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 re-delivers 378 transactions at 05:00 with txn_ts as epoch milliseconds (for example '1768716186000', which is 2026-01-18 06:03:06 UTC and matches the 02:00 copy of the same txn_id).
